title: Raw adic lisse data interfaces
statement: The unchanged interfaces used by raw-heart classical lisse stratification: for finite-field datum D, prime l different from its characteristic, finite coefficient fields E and an algebraic closure Omega, define canonical finite-type base adapters, coefficient-size and condensed-continuous comparison structures, the fully faithful normalized finite and common classical realizations, sf/PBC heart comparisons, one finite-stage reduced classical partition, the descended smooth affine closed frontier, and the rational lift of the actual restricted Weil iterate. These definitions retain all original normalized section, pullback, scalar, fibre and projection equations of lem-zl-raw-heart-adic-lisse-stratification; they assert no simultaneous existence. In particular Normalized is the conjunction of the lisse pull, field, point and common-stage normalizations. See the attached public declarations for the complete data fields.
